text: Which of the following statements about chemical equilibrium is correct? I. Le Chatelier's principle states that a system reinforces any change imposed on it II. Chemical equilibrium is static III. The concentrations of reactants and products remain constant at equilibrium
explanation:
The concentrations of reactants and products remain constant at equilibrium — this is correct.

The other two statements are not true: "Le Chatelier's principle states that a system reinforces any change imposed on it" and "Chemical equilibrium is static" both misstate the physics.

So only III is correct.
